conf.description: SOAR playbook/action execution history, api-pull: normalizes Splunk SOAR action_run/app_run and XSOAR task-entry records onto one accountability schema; folds exception_occurred into event.outcome; preserves parameter/result_summary as nested objects for Elastic's flattened mapping type rather than guessing a Cribl-side flatten conf.

conf.comment: xsoar-soar/action-execution/api-pull. No Elastic integration or Cribl Pack covers SOAR execution history. Splunk SOAR action_run/app_run and XSOAR task-entry field names are already clean identifiers (no awkward-name problem here). parameter/result_summary are connector-defined, unbounded, and their exact sub-keys are unknown, so they are renamed whole into the soar.action.* namespace and left nested rather than flattened/masked/lifted (documented gaps - see README) for Elastic's own 'flattened' mapping type to index.

functions.description: compute event.outcome (folding the child app_run exception flag per the work order's explicit warning that a parent can report success while a child raised an exception) and event.duration from ORIGINAL vendor names before the batched rename (ORDER MATTERS); user.effective.name is a value-add from the sibling 'creator' field the notes call out, not a formal field row
batch every clean-named field into its ECS/custom target in one rename ('message' is already the correct ECS name in both vendors' payloads, so it needs no rename)

drop the now-redundant status/creator working fields - _raw is deliberately KEPT (highest-forensic-value record on the technology per the work order; no concrete masking pattern given for parameter/result_summary - see README gap)
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
